cards.title: Choosing a stream after Class 10
facts: The main streams are Science (PCM or PCB), Commerce and Humanities/Arts; vocational subjects are also available.
Many careers are open from more than one stream.
Interest and aptitude predict success better than what friends choose.
do: List subjects you enjoy and do well in
Talk to a school counsellor and people working in fields you like
Take an aptitude or interest test
dont: Don't choose only because friends did
Don't assume one stream is 'better' than others

myths.statement: Only Science students can have successful careers.
myths.truth: Commerce and Humanities lead to careers like CA, law, design, psychology, economics, journalism and more.

quiz.q: What's the best basis for choosing a stream?
quiz.explanation: Interests and aptitude, plus good advice, lead to better choices.

cards.reviewNote: Drafted from widely published guidance. Needs expert review before launch.

cards.title: Diplomas and ITI courses
facts: Polytechnic diplomas can be started after Class 10 and usually take 3 years.
Diploma holders can often join an engineering degree directly in the second year (lateral entry).
ITIs offer skill-based trade courses such as electrician, fitter and mechanic.
do: Explore polytechnic and ITI options in your state
Check lateral-entry rules for degree courses
dont: Don't see diplomas as a 'lesser' option

myths.statement: After a diploma, you can never do an engineering degree.
myths.truth: Many states allow lateral entry into the second year of a B.Tech/B.E. after a diploma.

quiz.q: After a 3-year engineering diploma, many students can join a B.Tech in…
quiz.explanation: Lateral entry lets diploma holders join the second year in many states.

cards.reviewNote: Drafted from widely published guidance. Needs expert review before launch.

cards.title: Key entrance exams
facts: JEE Main is for engineering admissions; NEET-UG is for medical (MBBS/BDS) admissions.
CUET-UG is used for admission to many central and other universities.
CLAT is for national law universities; NID and NIFT have their own design entrance tests.
Official information is published on the exam websites, e.g. nta.ac.in.
do: Check official exam websites for dates and eligibility
Plan preparation early in Class 11
dont: Don't rely only on social media rumours about exams

myths.statement: CUET is only for engineering colleges.
myths.truth: CUET-UG is used for admission to many universities across arts, science and commerce programmes.

quiz.q: Which exam is used for medical (MBBS) admissions in India?
quiz.explanation: NEET-UG is the national entrance test for MBBS/BDS admissions.

cards.reviewNote: Drafted from widely published guidance. Needs expert review before launch.

cards.title: Day in the life: Software Engineer and technologist
facts: Software engineering is about creative problem-solving and logic, not just writing syntax.
Engineers spend significant time collaborating in team standups, reading architecture docs, and reviewing code.
do: Focus on building strong fundamentals in mathematics, logic, and computational thinking
Work on personal mini-projects (building a website, automating a study task, creating a game)
Explore free platforms like Python tutorials, CS50, and open-source GitHub repositories
dont: Never believe that you must be a mathematical genius to learn coding
Never copy-paste code without understanding the underlying logic

myths.statement: Software engineers work alone in dark rooms staring at green matrix code without speaking to anyone.
myths.truth: Modern software engineering is highly collaborative, requiring teamwork, user empathy, and clear communication.

quiz.q: What foundational skill is most important for a career in software technology?
options: Logical problem solving, curiosity, and structured thinking
quiz.explanation: Problem decomposition and algorithmic logic form the core of computer science.

situations: A Class 10 student at {at} wants to explore whether software engineering is the right fit.
scenario.question: How can {name} evaluate and explore this career pathway?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Start building small hands-on projects with Python, HTML, or Scratch
rubric.note: Validates practical interest through active building.

rubric.point: Recognize that collaboration, communication, and debugging resilience matter as much as coding
Explore streams with Mathematics after Class 10 (Science or Commerce with Math)
rubric.note: Ensures academic eligibility for tech degrees.

dangerous: memorize coding books without touching a computer

sources.name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

cards.title: Day in the life: Doctor, nurse and healthcare professionals
facts: Healthcare careers require deep biological science knowledge paired with profound human empathy.
Pathways extend beyond MBBS to Nursing, Physiotherapy, Pharmacy, Radiology, and Medical Research.
do: Study Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) in Classes 11 and 12
Develop emotional resilience, patient active listening, and calmness under pressure
Explore allied healthcare fields: clinical psychology, biomechanics, biomedical tech, and public health
dont: Never choose medicine solely because of parental or social prestige pressure
Never underestimate the dedication, long hours, and rigorous years of residency required

myths.statement: The only respectable and successful career in healthcare is becoming an MBBS surgeon.
myths.truth: Modern healthcare relies equally on nurse specialists, biomedical engineers, radiographers, and pharmacologists.

quiz.q: What academic stream subject combination is required in Class 11-12 for medical entrance exams like NEET?
quiz.explanation: NEET eligibility mandates studying Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Biotechnology in senior secondary.

situations: A student at {at} is passionate about helping sick people but is unsure about the MBBS journey.
scenario.question: How should {name} help them explore healthcare broadly?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explain that healthcare includes vital fields like Nursing, Physiotherapy, Pharmacy, and Biotechnology
rubric.note: Broadens perspective beyond single entrance exams.

rubric.point: Discuss the daily reality: empathy, shift work, continuous learning, and patient care
rubric.note: Gives balanced, realistic picture of medical life.

rubric.point: Prepare strong fundamentals in PCB while exploring volunteer hospital internships

cards.title: Day in the life: Product and UI/UX Designer
facts: Design is how something works and solves human problems, not just pretty decoration.
UI/UX designers conduct user interviews, sketch wireframes, and design intuitive digital experiences.
do: Cultivate visual curiosity, user empathy, and problem observation in everyday life
Build a diverse design portfolio showcasing how you solved a real problem (sketches, prototypes)
Prepare for design entrance exams: UCEED (IITs), NID DAT, and NIFT
dont: Never think you cannot be a designer because you can't paint realistic oil portraits
Never design interfaces without interviewing real users about their difficulties

myths.statement: Design is purely an art career for people who failed at science and commerce.
myths.truth: Product and UX design combine cognitive psychology, technology, data analytics, and ergonomics.

quiz.q: Which premier Indian institutions offer Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programs via UCEED?
options: Indian Institutes of Technology (IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati)
quiz.explanation: UCEED is the national entrance examination for B.Des programs across leading IITs and design institutes.

situations: A Class 11 student at {at} loves both technology and drawing and wonders about career paths.
scenario.question: How can {name} introduce them to User Experience (UX) design?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explain that UX designers build intuitive interfaces that make apps easy for everyone to use
Encourage them to build a portfolio of wireframes, problem solutions, and sketches
rubric.note: Portfolio-based evaluation is key to design admissions.

rubric.point: Explore entrance exams like UCEED and NID DAT open to students from any stream

dangerous: force them to abandon creative interests

cards.title: Day in the life: Chartered Accountant and Financial Analyst
facts: Chartered Accountants (CAs) manage taxation, financial audits, corporate strategy, and forensic accounting.
The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) oversees the rigorous three-stage CA qualification.
do: Build rock-solid foundations in accountancy, business economics, and commercial law
Develop sharp analytical attention to detail, numerical integrity, and ethical responsibility
Register for the ICAI CA Foundation examination after appearing for Class 12 board exams
dont: Never assume CA is only about calculating routine math sums on a calculator
Never compromise on financial ethics and corporate audit transparency

myths.statement: You must have studied Commerce in Class 11-12 to register for the CA Foundation exam.
myths.truth: Students from ANY stream (Science, Commerce, or Arts) can appear for the ICAI CA Foundation exam.

quiz.q: Which statutory professional body regulates the Chartered Accountancy profession in India?
options: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
quiz.explanation: ICAI is established under an Act of Parliament to regulate the CA profession.

situations: A student at {at} enjoys numbers, business case studies, and corporate analysis.
scenario.question: How should {name} structure their career exploration for Chartered Accountancy?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explain the three-stage pathway: CA Foundation, CA Intermediate, and Articleship/Final
Highlight the diverse career roles: forensic auditor, tax advisor, CFO, or financial analyst
Emphasize that discipline, analytical rigor, and ethics are paramount

sources.name: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

cards.title: Day in the life: Lawyer, legal advocate and corporate counsel
facts: Law is the framework that safeguards fundamental rights, contracts, justice, and social democracy.
Modern legal practice spans litigation, corporate mergers, intellectual property, and environmental law.
do: Cultivate extensive reading habits, critical reasoning, and objective argument construction
Prepare for national law entrance exams like the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) for National Law Universities (NLUs)
Participate in school debating, Model United Nations (MUN), and moot court simulations
dont: Never assume courtroom litigation is identical to dramatic Bollywood movie scenes
Never rely on emotion over documented constitutional case law and evidence

myths.statement: To become a corporate lawyer, you must study science in school.
myths.truth: Law entrance exams (CLAT) test English, Current Affairs, Legal Reasoning, and Logical Reasoning, open to all streams.

quiz.q: What entrance exam provides admission to the premier National Law Universities (NLUs) in India?
quiz.explanation: CLAT is the centralized entrance examination for 5-year integrated BA LLB / BBA LLB programs at 24 NLUs.

situations: A student passionate about justice, constitutional rights, and public speaking at {at} asks about law.
scenario.question: How can {name} guide their legal career roadmap?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Introduce the 5-year integrated law degree (BA LLB/BBA LLB) via entrance exams like CLAT
rubric.note: Clear academic entry point after Class 12.

rubric.point: Discuss varied career paths: court litigation, corporate law, public policy, and judicial services
rubric.note: Broadens perspective across diverse legal sectors.

rubric.point: Encourage deep reading of newspapers, editorial analysis, and critical logical argumentation

dangerous: say lawyers only argue in court

cards.title: Day in the life: Data Analyst and Artificial Intelligence practitioner
facts: Data analysts find actionable trends in massive datasets; AI engineers build predictive machine learning models.
Core disciplines combine statistics, linear algebra, Python programming, and domain business knowledge.
do: Build a strong foundation in high school statistics, probability, and linear algebra
Learn Python libraries: Pandas for data manipulation, Matplotlib for charts, and Scikit-learn for models
Explore public open data repositories (like Kaggle or Government Data Portal data.gov.in)
dont: Never treat AI as a magic black box without understanding the underlying math and data bias
Never use uncleaned, unverified data to draw definitive statistical conclusions

myths.statement: You need a supercomputer to start learning data analytics and artificial intelligence.
myths.truth: Free cloud platforms like Google Colab let students train machine learning models on basic laptops.

quiz.q: What branch of mathematics forms the absolute core foundation of data science and machine learning?
quiz.explanation: Machine learning models are fundamentally statistical optimization algorithms.

situations: A Class 11 student at {at} wants to pursue Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
scenario.question: What practical, grounded advice should {name} share?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Strengthen school mathematics, especially statistics, probability, and functions
rubric.note: Mathematical foundations enable deep AI comprehension.

rubric.point: Start learning Python programming and explore datasets on Google Colab or Kaggle
Understand that ethical AI requires eliminating data bias and respecting user privacy

sources.name: National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM FutureSkills)

cards.title: Day in the life: Teacher, professor and education mentor
facts: Educators shape the intellectual foundations of the next generation of scientists, leaders, and artists.
Modern teaching combines subject expertise, learning psychology, curriculum design, and ed-tech tools.
do: Pursue bachelor's degrees in your passion subject, followed by B.Ed (for schools) or Master's/PhD (for universities)
Qualify eligibility exams: CTET/STET (for school teachers) or UGC NET (for college professorships)
Develop patience, inspiring public communication, and student-centered mentoring empathy
dont: Never view teaching as a fallback option when other jobs fail; it is a foundational calling
Never stop learning new pedagogy methods and modern digital classroom tools

myths.statement: School teachers only work 4 hours a day and have zero work outside the classroom.
myths.truth: Dedicated teachers spend countless hours preparing lessons, evaluating feedback, and mentoring students.

quiz.q: What national eligibility test is required to teach in central government schools (like Kendriya Vidyalayas)?
quiz.explanation: CTET conducted by CBSE certifies teachers for Classes 1 to 8 across central schools.

situations: A student at {at} loves explaining difficult science concepts to peers and wants to become a teacher.
scenario.question: How can {name} validate and plan this rewarding career path?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Guide them through the pathway: Bachelor's degree in science, followed by B.Ed and CTET
Encourage them to practice mentoring younger students and designing simple study notes
Highlight diverse modern roles: school educator, university professor, curriculum writer, ed-tech designer

cards.title: Serving the nation: Armed Forces (NDA/CDS) and Civil Services (UPSC)
facts: The Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) offer leadership, discipline, adventure, and patriotic duty.
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) selects civil servants (IAS, IPS, IFS) for national governance.
do: Apply for the National Defence Academy (NDA) entrance exam conducted by UPSC after Class 12 (now open to women)
Maintain high physical fitness (running, pull-ups, stamina) alongside mental general awareness for the SSB interview
For Civil Services (IAS/IPS), complete any graduation degree and build vast general studies knowledge
dont: Never believe that civil services or defence exams require joining expensive coaching mafias
Never neglect physical fitness and sports if aiming for the armed forces

myths.statement: Women cannot join the combat wings of the Indian Armed Forces or appear for the NDA exam.
myths.truth: Following landmark Supreme Court rulings, women cadets now train at NDA and serve as combat officers across Army, Navy, and Air Force.

quiz.q: When can students appear for the National Defence Academy (NDA) entrance examination?
options: While appearing in Class 12 or immediately after passing Class 12
quiz.explanation: The NDA exam is conducted twice yearly by UPSC for 16.5 to 19.5 year old Class 12 students.

situations: A student at {at} dreams of wearing the uniform and serving the nation in the Armed Forces.
scenario.question: What roadmap should {name} outline?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Prepare for the NDA entrance examination (Mathematics and General Ability) during Class 12
rubric.keys: nda entrance exam|upsc nda|class 12|maths and gat

rubric.point: Maintain rigorous physical conditioning and prepare for the 5-day SSB interview process
Note that both young women and men are eligible for officer commissions via NDA
rubric.keys: open to women and men|equal opportunity

dangerous: pay bribes to fake recruiting agents
assume defence is only for boys

sources.name: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC NDA Portal)

cards.title: Modern Agriculture: Agritech, soil science and smart farming
facts: Modern agriculture merges satellite data, drone spraying, genetic crop breeding, and supply-chain logistics.
ICAR oversees agricultural universities offering B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture and Food Technology.
do: Explore agricultural entrance exams: ICAR AIEEA for national agricultural university admissions
Study subjects like plant genetics, hydroponics, precision drip irrigation, and post-harvest preservation
Look into entrepreneurship opportunities: organic export, agritech startups, and cold-storage supply chains
dont: Never view farming through outdated lenses; modern agriculture is a high-tech multibillion-dollar industry
Never assume agricultural science has no global corporate career avenues

myths.statement: A degree in Agriculture only prepares students to do manual ploughing in fields.
myths.truth: Agricultural graduates work as agronomists, drone specialists, commodity analysts, and food processing scientists.

quiz.q: Which premier national body coordinates agricultural education and research across Indian universities?
quiz.explanation: ICAR is the apex national body coordinating agricultural research and higher education.

situations: A student from a farming family at {at} wants to modernize their family's agriculture.
scenario.question: How can {name} guide their higher education pathway?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explore B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture or Agricultural Engineering through ICAR AIEEA entrance exams
Highlight exciting modern domains: precision drone farming, soil chemistry, hydroponics, and seed biotech
Discuss agritech entrepreneurship: direct farm-to-consumer supply chains and export markets

dangerous: tell them to abandon agriculture entirely

cards.title: Careers in Sports: Athletes, coaching, physiotherapy and sports management
facts: The sports industry has exploded beyond professional athletes to sports science, analytics, and leagues.
Sports science professionals support athletes with biomechanics, nutrition, and injury rehabilitation.
do: Pursue specialized degrees: B.Sc. Sports Science, Sports Physiotherapy, or Sports Management
Look into coaching diplomas from the National Institute of Sports (NIS Patiala / SAI)
Gain experience with sports journalism, event management, and sports video analytics
dont: Never assume that if you don't become a national cricket player, you cannot work in sports
Never neglect academic qualifications while training in competitive athletics

myths.statement: If you don't play for Team India, there are zero jobs available in the sports sector.
myths.truth: IPL teams, academies, and brands employ thousands of sports physios, performance analysts, and league managers.

quiz.q: Which premier institute under the Sports Authority of India (SAI) trains certified sports coaches?
options: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NIS Patiala)
quiz.explanation: NIS Patiala is Asia's largest sports institute, producing India's top certified Olympic and national coaches.

situations: A student at {at} loves sports deeply but knows making the national team is statistically challenging.
scenario.question: What diverse sports industry careers can {name} introduce?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explore high-demand allied fields: Sports Physiotherapy, Sports Nutrition, and Strength & Conditioning
rubric.note: Leverages athletic passion with medical science.

rubric.point: Look into modern business avenues: Sports Management, Tournament Operations, and Sports Analytics
Check degree programs under the Sports Authority of India and sports universities

dangerous: say sports is a waste of life
tell them to give up sports

cards.title: Day in the life: Journalist, content creator and documentary filmmaker
facts: Journalism is the 'Fourth Pillar' of democracy, holding power accountable and informing citizens.
Modern media blends investigative writing, podcasting, data journalism, and video editing.
do: Cultivate voracious reading habits, ethical fact-checking, and strong written storytelling
Pursue degrees in Journalism, Mass Communication, or Film Studies (IIMC, Jamia, FTII)
Start writing articles for school magazines, local newsletters, or producing audio-video mini-documentaries
dont: Never report unverified WhatsApp forwards or sensational rumors as news
Never compromise on journalistic truth and neutral verification for cheap viral clicks

myths.statement: Journalism is just screaming loudly on sensational television debate panels.
myths.truth: True journalism is deep investigative research, ground reporting, and presenting verified facts calmly.

quiz.q: What premier national institute under the Ministry of I&B trains elite journalists in India?
quiz.explanation: IIMC is India's premier government institution for post-graduate mass communication and journalism.

situations: A student at {at} loves writing, questioning community issues, and making documentary videos.
scenario.question: How should {name} structure their media and journalism exploration?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Build strong writing and critical fact-checking habits across school publications and blogs
Explore degree programs in Mass Communication, Media Studies, and Film Making (e.g. IIMC)
Emphasize ethical responsibility: fighting fake news, verifying sources, and speaking truth

dangerous: teach them to make fake news

cards.title: National scholarship portals: Legitimate schemes vs fake fee scams
facts: Government and institutional scholarships fund school and university fees for deserving students.
Legitimate scholarship schemes NEVER charge application fees or ask for processing deposits.
do: Apply for government scholarships exclusively through the official National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Explore central and state merit-cum-means schemes, PM-YASASVI, and NMMS for school students
Keep verified documents ready: Aadhaar, income certificate, school bonafide, and student bank passbook
dont: Never pay money to private agents claiming to 'guarantee' a scholarship approval
Never share OTPs or banking PINs with unverified scholarship websites

myths.statement: If a scholarship portal asks for a ₹500 'verification processing fee', it is a standard government requirement.
myths.truth: Official Indian government scholarships are 100% free. Any site asking for payment is a cyber scam.

quiz.q: What is the single official central government web portal for all Indian student scholarships?
quiz.explanation: The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is the unified government window for central and state schemes.

situations: A student's family at {at} wants financial assistance for higher schooling but worries about fake scams.
scenario.question: How can {name} guide them safely?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Direct them strictly to the official National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
rubric.note: Authentic government portal with direct bank benefit transfer.

rubric.point: Warn them that legitimate government scholarships NEVER charge any application fee
rubric.keys: never pay fees|free application|no scam agents

rubric.point: Help them assemble authentic documents: income certificate, marksheet, and Aadhaar-linked account

sources.name: National Scholarship Portal (Ministry of Electronics and IT)

cards.title: Vocational skilling: ITI, polytechnic diplomas and practical trades
facts: Skill-based technical trades (electrician, CNC machinist, solar technician) offer high employability.
Polytechnic diplomas allow direct lateral entry into the 2nd year of B.Tech engineering degrees.
do: Explore Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and Polytechnic Diplomas after Class 10
Gain hands-on practical skills aligned with the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)
Look into emerging vocational trades: drone pilot licensing, EV mechanic, and renewable tech installation
dont: Never look down upon vocational technical education compared to traditional general degrees
Never enroll in uncertified private training institutes without DGT / NCVT affiliation

myths.statement: Students who attend ITI or Polytechnic institutes cannot go to college or get high-paying jobs.
myths.truth: Skilled technicians earn excellent salaries, launch manufacturing businesses, or take lateral entry into engineering degrees.

quiz.q: What official government certification ensures an ITI trade course is nationally recognized?
options: National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT / DGT) certification
quiz.explanation: NCVT certification ensures trade qualifications are recognized by government and multinational industries.

situations: A Class 10 student at {at} prefers hands-on mechanical building over memorizing abstract textbooks.
scenario.question: How can {name} present vocational education proudly?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Explain that Polytechnic Diplomas and ITIs provide rapid, high-demand practical technical skills
Highlight the lateral entry pathway: diploma graduates can enter 2nd year B.Tech directly
Emphasize high-growth future trades like Electric Vehicle (EV) maintenance and solar installation

sources.name: Directorate General of Training (DGT - Ministry of Skill Development)

cards.title: Building a real profile: Projects, volunteering and student initiatives
facts: Colleges, scholarship committees, and employers look for initiative, grit, and real-world impact.
Building a working prototype or leading a community literacy drive outshines empty test scores.
do: Initiate or join school clubs: coding club, eco-club, robotics, debate society, or literary circle
Volunteer for verified community causes: teaching younger kids, animal shelter care, or park cleanups
Document your projects in a simple portfolio or blog showing what you learned and solved
dont: Never participate in activities just to collect fake participation certificates
Never plagiarize someone else's project work and claim it as your own

myths.statement: Only students with 99% board marks get selected for top university scholarships and internships.
myths.truth: Top universities practice holistic review, prioritizing student leadership, curiosity, and tangible projects.

quiz.q: What makes a student project stand out on a college scholarship application?
options: Solving a genuine community problem with documented effort, reflection, and impact
quiz.explanation: Authentic problem-solving demonstrates maturity, leadership, and intellectual curiosity.

situations: A Class 11 student at {at} wants to build an impressive profile for future college applications.
scenario.question: What impactful roadmap should {name} recommend?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Pick a genuine real-world problem and build a mini-project (e.g. school compost bin, app, or reading drive)
Lead school club activities or volunteer with local verified community groups
Reflect on learning and document the journey honestly in a student portfolio

cards.title: Spotting fake colleges, unaccredited degrees and fraudulent agents
facts: Enrolling in an unrecognized institution results in worthless degrees ineligible for jobs or government exams.
The University Grants Commission (UGC) and AICTE publish yearly public lists of fake and unaccredited universities.
do: Check university accreditation status on the official UGC website (ugc.ac.in) before applying
Verify technical and engineering college approvals on the AICTE portal (aicte-india.org)
Beware of glossy brochures promising '100% Guaranteed Foreign Placement' with zero entrance requirements
dont: Never pay non-refundable admissions fees to unregistered educational consultancies or agents
Never take admission in an institute listed on the UGC Fake University Warning List

myths.statement: If a college has a fancy multi-story glass building and celebrity ads, its degrees are automatically recognized.
myths.truth: Physical architecture does not equal legal accreditation. Always verify statutory UGC/AICTE approval.

quiz.q: Which statutory government body maintains the official public list of recognized universities and fake colleges in India?
quiz.explanation: UGC is the statutory authority maintaining the official list of recognized central, state, and private universities.

situations: A glossy brochure at {at} promises: 'Instant B.Tech Degree in 1 year, no exams needed, apply now!'
scenario.question: What critical red flags does {name} point out?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: B.Tech degrees cannot be completed in 1 year; this is a fraudulent fake degree scam
Check the institution's legal approval status on the official UGC and AICTE websites
Warn peers never to pay money to unaccredited institutions that sell worthless certificates
rubric.note: Shields peers from financial and career loss.

dangerous: pay the fee for instant degree

sources.name: University Grants Commission (UGC List of Fake Universities)

cards.title: Stream pressure and changing pathways: It is okay to pivot
facts: Many students realize their selected Class 11 stream (Science/Commerce/Arts) does not align with their passions.
The National Education Policy (NEP 2020) encourages multidisciplinary flexibility across subjects.
do: Recognize that discovering what you DO NOT like is valuable progress toward finding your true calling
Consult a certified school career counselor to assess transferable skills and bridge courses
Remember that undergraduate admissions (law, design, management, humanities) are open to all streams
dont: Never consider yourself a failure because a chosen stream feels unfulfilling
Never suffer in severe silent misery without speaking to parents and counselors

myths.statement: If you choose Science in Class 11, you must become an engineer or your life is over.
myths.truth: Thousands of science students pivot successfully to design, law, management, writing, civil services, and entrepreneurship.

quiz.q: What does the National Education Policy (NEP) promote regarding secondary education streams?
options: Multidisciplinary flexibility, eliminating rigid boundaries between arts and sciences
quiz.explanation: NEP promotes cross-disciplinary learning, allowing students to study physics with music or economics with history.

situations: A Class 12 student at {at} feels completely exhausted by engineering coaching and dreams of business and design.
scenario.question: What reassuring guidance should {name} provide?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Assure them that changing career directions is normal, common, and completely okay
rubric.keys: it'?s okay to change|normal to pivot|no failure

rubric.point: Explain that entrance exams for design (UCEED), law (CLAT), and management are open to all streams
Encourage an honest, constructive dialogue with family about their true strengths and goals

dangerous: tell them they are a failure
force them to suffer in silence

cards.title: Constructive career conversations with parents
facts: Parents worry primarily about their children's future financial security, career stability, and happiness.
Presenting well-researched career pathways, college options, and job outlooks dispels parental anxiety.
do: Prepare for the conversation: research top accredited colleges, admission criteria, and alumni career outcomes
Acknowledge their concern: 'I know you want me to be secure, here is how this field offers real careers'
Schedule a calm, dedicated discussion time without angry shouting or defensive arguments
dont: Never scream: 'You are ruining my life!' during a heated argument
Never demand approval for an unconventional career without having done basic research on it

myths.statement: Parents who suggest traditional engineering or medicine only want to control and punish their children.
myths.truth: Parents recommend traditional paths because they represent proven financial stability in their experience.

quiz.q: What is the most persuasive way to present an unconventional career goal (like animation or sports) to parents?
options: Presenting a clear, researched plan showing accredited colleges, realistic costs, and career opportunities
quiz.explanation: Preparation and researched facts demonstrate maturity, turning parental anxiety into proud support.

situations: A student at {at} wants to pursue Psychology or Culinary Arts, but parents insist on engineering coaching.
scenario.question: How should {name} structure a mature family conversation?
scenario.bubble: What is the safest move right now?

rubric.point: Prepare a structured presentation showing top universities, curriculum, and diverse job roles
rubric.note: Substitutes vague dreams with concrete research.

rubric.point: Acknowledge parental love and financial security concerns with respect and empathy
Invite a school career counselor or neutral industry professional to join the discussion
